prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a high-resolution landscape art-direction comparison board with THREE equally wide vertical panels side by side, each a genuinely distinct visual direction for "The Punisher", a playful couples accountability app built around Angel and Devil roles, agreeing tasks and receiving rewards or playful consequences. This is a moodboard exploring artwork styles, not a website screenshot. Large sophisticated white numbered headings at top of each panel only: "01 SCULPTURAL", "02 CINEMATIC", "03 SYMBOLIC". At bottom of each scene a small tasteful "The Punisher" title. No other small text needed.
Common narrative across panels: Angel and Devil connected by a shared task, a gift represents reward, and neatly stacked dishes represent a playful consequence. Not conflict, not a battle. Avoid caricatures, cartoon faces, oversized eyes or heads, Pixar/Disney look, chibi, plastic toys, cute fantasy costumes, oversaturated colors, glowing spaghetti lines, lavish wedding decoration. All typography exact, restrained and editorial. No skull logo, violence or weapons.
Panel 01 SCULPTURAL: photograph of a museum-quality contemporary sculptural installation, physically carved white marble adult angel with finely articulated feather wings and a slender aged-brass halo, facing a deep oxblood stone adult devil with subtle horns. Believable classically sculpted adult anatomy and faces; natural stone, not colored skin, not cartoon. Half-length sculptures integrated into a single broad dark travertine pedestal; a modest upright phone with one minimal task/check icon between them, a beautifully sculpted brass gift and small porcelain dish stack inset in front. Generous breathing room, deep charcoal gallery backdrop, directional warm museum spotlight, deep contact shadows, tactile chisel marks and marble veins, restrained old-master atmosphere, very sophisticated and architectural.
Panel 02 CINEMATIC: editorial photograph of two real adult partners in their early 30s, natural human faces and proportions, authentic pores and realistic fabric. A woman in ivory tailored silk with a subtle thin halo and realistic ivory feather wings, a man in dark burgundy tailoring with small dark curved horns. Seated opposite one another at a contemporary dark walnut table, sharing a phone at the center and exchanging a knowing understated smile. Gift box and dishes on table imply their agreement. Eye-level intimate framing, dramatic practical amber lamp light and soft cool window light, film grain, rich natural shadows. Art-house cinematic campaign photography; no illustration or fantasy princess styling.
Panel 03 SYMBOLIC: meticulously photographed minimal luxury product installation, no human figures. A vertical black-glass smartphone stands between a sculptural ivory wing and thin brass halo on one side and a curved oxblood horn and elegant pointed tail on the other. Two clean inset pathways lead from the central shared task icon to a small brushed-gold gift and an ivory stack of dishes. Carved limestone platform, oxblood lacquer, brushed brass, satin glass, architectural studio backdrop, sophisticated warm chiaroscuro. Strong sculptural silhouettes and precise material detail. This should be the most feasible direction for a matching interactive 3D model.
Make each panel feel like a different professional art direction with consistent high-end presentation. All main subjects visible, carefully separated by narrow dark gutters, no decorative border. Prioritize believable materials, grounded lighting and mature art direction over fantasy ornament.
